purpose: Check that security reviews inspect trust boundaries and backend enforcement.
positivePrompts: Do a security-privacy-review of this admin API change.
Review permissions, sensitive data, webhooks, billing abuse, and data minimization.

cases.prompt: A patch hides admin controls in the UI but moves the endpoint to a shared route.
checks: Checks backend authorization, not only frontend visibility.
Defines assets, actors, trust boundaries, and sensitive data.
Recommends tests or controls for the permission boundary.

cases.prompt: Review this payment retry patch. Provider timeouts after request acceptance are uncommon; decide whether the risk blocks release or can be tracked separately.
checks: Separates impact severity, evidence confidence, occurrence likelihood, and release disposition.
Marks the credible duplicate-charge path Blocking despite low likelihood.
Ties the verdict to the changed idempotency key and absence of reconciliation or refund.

traceExpectations: Data minimization is considered for sensitive flows.
New regression is distinguished from existing policy.
Findings separate impact severity, evidence confidence, occurrence likelihood, and release disposition.
Low-likelihood authorization, privacy, cross-tenant, data-loss, or financial risks remain blocking when supported by concrete evidence.
The review states an overall verdict and explicitly says when there are no blocking findings.
